name: How long does bathroom flooring installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom flooring installation depends on several factors, including the type of material, the size of the bathroom, and the existing subfloor condition. Simple vinyl installations might take 1-2 days, while ceramic or porcelain tile, which involves mortar setting and grout curing, can take 3-5 days. If old flooring needs extensive removal or subfloor repairs are required, the project timeline will be extended. We'll provide a more precise timeline during the consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time ranges from 1-2 days for simple vinyl to 3-5 days for tile, depending on material, bathroom size, and subfloor condition.
